name: IPGuardian (keyless blocklist aggregator check)
tier_rationale: P150 final condition 1: terms 'unknown' and tier unknown until legal records them (operator and data handling not reviewed). Disabled in every profile until then; afterwards opt-in, excluded at AMBER and above, --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN, IOC_TYPES only.

reliability.justification: Re-aggregates 140+ public blocklists (FireHOL and others) that P149 already matches locally; one vote at most, never above LOW alone (P150 FC3).

error_markers.reason: IPGuardian: success:false in an HTTP 200 body

check.title: IPGuardian blocklist check (POST https://ipguardian.net/api/check {"ip": ...}): names of the public blocklists that list the IP
check.notes: P150 FC1: terms not reviewed (research record C0339 'IPGuardian terms (free)', no published text recorded). Invalid input: HTTP 400 {error:'Invalid IP addresses'} -> ERROR. List names are deduplicated against the P149 feeds (one vote at most).
